newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes climb higher on futures bullish action.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes climb higher on futures bullish action.

text.p: Cash crudes in the U.S. climbed higher Thursday, ending well above the $25.00 a barrel mark on continued bullish buying on the NYMEX futures market.
A slew of factors were seen supporting the crude outright ascent, offsetting expectations for the return of Iraqi crude to world markets sometime in December.

Cash grade differentials held in steady territory, attracting sales throughout a moderately busy session. Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James maintained a 90 cts premium to the January West Texas Intermediate/Cushing marker. Spot cash WTI ended at $25.55-65 a barrel, 60 cents higher than Wednesday.
